verdict.rationale: Solid's own repository says state management is built in through Context and Stores, so developers 'don't have to reach for a third party library to manage global state.' Signals with automatic dependency tracking and Resources for server data back this up as first-party state primitives that ship with the framework itself. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Stores API (nested/global store patterns), and independent hands-on reports specifically about using Solid's Stores at scale.
